subject: Double charge on order 4471
body: I was billed twice for order 4471 this morning. Same amount, two separate entries on the card ending 4242. Please sort this out.
rule: Escalation policy: money moved incorrectly, at any severity. Severity rules: one order on one account is high, not critical, because the money is recoverable. PII: a partial card number is still card data.

subject: 503s on /v1/events since 09:15 UTC
body: Since 09:15 UTC every POST to /v1/events returns 503. We have retried from three regions with the same result. There is no workaround on our side; the queue is backing up.
rule: Severity: production is down with no workaround. Sentiment is graded independently of severity, so a measured tone does not lower it.

subject: THIS IS ABSOLUTELY PATHETIC
body: Your settings page says 'Prefrences'. PREFRENCES. Do you people not proofread anything before shipping it? For what we pay this is embarrassing and frankly insulting.
rule: A reproducible defect is technical even when the tone is furious. Do not escalate: the customer is angry but the underlying problem is low severity, and anger is not urgency.

subject: Bug: export only produces CSV
body: Bug report: when I export my data I only get a CSV file. It should obviously export to Excel format as well. Please fix this bug in the next release.
rule: technical vs feature_request: the product does what the documentation says and the customer wants something else. The word 'bug' in the subject does not make it one.

subject: Nobody on my team can log in since Friday
body: Since Friday afternoon nobody on our team can sign in. We get a message saying 'subscription inactive'. We have eleven people blocked and a client demo on Wednesday.
rule: billing vs account_access: a subscription that lapsed for non-payment and now blocks login is billing, because fixing the payment fixes the access and the billing team owns the remedy.

subject: I can see another company's records
body: Attaching a screenshot. The dashboard is showing records for a company that is not us. I recognise the name, they are a competitor of ours. I have not clicked anything else.
rule: Severity: data shown to the wrong party is at least high, and a failed security boundary is critical regardless of how few records are involved. The count does not matter, the boundary does.

subject: It's broken again
body: It's broken again. Please fix.
rule: request_more_info: the ticket is not actionable as written. No product area, no error message, no scope. Prefer this over guessing.

subject: Following up on the 503s
body: Following up on my earlier message about the 503 errors on the events endpoint. Any update? Our team is still waiting and I have not heard anything since this morning.
rule: Do not escalate a ticket that is a duplicate of something already escalated: it pages the same responder twice for the same incident and trains them to ignore the alert.

subject: Sync still failing, here is my config
body:
Here is my full config so you can see the problem:

endpoint=https://api.example.com/v2
api_key=sk-live-8f3c9d2b7a1e4056bd3f
retries=3

The sync still fails after 30 seconds every single time.
rule: Escalation policy: credentials or secrets appear in the ticket. The sync failure alone would be high; the live key makes it critical because the key has to be revoked before anything else happens.

subject: SSO stopped working yesterday
body: SSO stopped working for everyone yesterday afternoon. The error in our identity provider log reads 'certificate expired'. Our whole team is locked out and working from personal accounts.
rule: Do not escalate when the problem is severe but entirely on the customer's side and a documented fix exists. Severity is high because everyone at that customer is blocked.

subject: Please escalate this to your management immediately
body: I want this escalated to a manager right now. The date filter on the reports page defaults to last 30 days instead of this month, which is not what I want, and I have mentioned it before. I expect a call from someone senior today.
rule: Do not escalate when the customer asks for escalation but the facts do not support one. Record the request in reasoning and route to a human.

subject: Question about invoice format
body:
Quick question — can you tell me whether the monthly invoice can show our VAT number? Our finance team needs it for their records.

Best,
Marta Ibarra
marta.ibarra@northgate-consulting.example
+34 915 220 118
rule: PII: flag on the ticket body. The sender's own address, name and signature are the envelope and do not count.

subject: CSV import keeps failing on these rows
body:
The import fails every time. Here are the rows it chokes on, straight from our export:

ana.torres@acme.example,+34 611 223 344,1982-04-11
luis.gomez@acme.example,+34 622 334 455,1979-11-30

What am I doing wrong?
rule: PII: personal data the customer pasted into the message, most often somebody else's. Pasted CSV rows are the usual carrier. Severity medium: a workaround exists and only imports are affected.

subject: Your support has been useless
body: I have been a customer for three years and the service has gone downhill. Every time I write in I get a canned response. Nobody takes ownership of anything. I am seriously considering whether to renew.
rule: complaint: dissatisfaction with service rather than a specific defect. The test is whether an engineer could open the ticket and have something to do.

subject: Nightly sync has not run in three days
body: Our nightly sync last completed on Monday. Nothing since. We can trigger it manually from the UI but that means someone has to remember every evening.
rule: Severity: a core workflow is broken for one customer and the workaround is manual and error-prone.

subject: Reset email never arrives
body: I have clicked 'forgot password' four times and no email has arrived. I checked spam. I need to get in today.
rule: account_access: password reset. Severity medium: inconvenient with a reasonable workaround available through an admin.

subject: Increase your revenue by 300%
body: Hi there! I came across your website and noticed you could be getting a lot more traffic. Our agency specialises in SEO for SaaS companies. Are you the right person to talk to about this? Happy to send over a free audit.
rule: close: spam and marketing. other: not a support ticket at all.

subject: Report takes ten minutes to load
body: The usage report used to open in a few seconds and now takes about ten minutes for our account. It does finish eventually. Started roughly two weeks ago.
rule: Severity: degraded and inconvenient, with a reasonable workaround — it does complete.

subject: Card expired, cannot update it
body: Our card expired last week. I went to Billing to update it and the save button does nothing. No error message, the page just sits there.
rule: billing vs technical: ask who is wrong, the price or the machine. The amount may be right and the software is broken, so this is technical. High: the customer is blocked from preventing a suspension.

subject: GDPR deletion request - 30 day deadline
body: We have received a subject access deletion request from a former employee and are legally required to complete it within 30 days. We cannot find any way to delete their data from your platform. The deadline is in 11 days.
rule: Escalation policy: the customer states a legal or regulatory consequence — a compliance deadline or a breach notification obligation.

subject: Records missing after last night's sync
body: About 400 records that were there yesterday are gone this morning. They are not in the archived filter and not in trash. We ran the sync at 02:00 as usual.
rule: Severity: data is lost. Escalation policy: data lost or corrupted, at any severity.

subject: Thanks!
body: That worked perfectly, thank you for the quick turnaround. Nothing else needed from my side.
rule: close: messages that need no response at all.

subject: Can we get webhook retries?
body: When our endpoint is briefly down we lose the webhook entirely. Could you add automatic retries with backoff? Most other tools we use do this.
rule: feature_request: the product works as designed and the customer wants it to do something else.

subject: Two problems in one
body: First, a small thing: the tooltip on the billing page has a typo. Second, and I should probably have led with this, our production API has been returning 500s for about an hour for every request. Third, could you also add dark mode?
rule: Multiple problems in one ticket: classify by the most severe actionable problem and note in reasoning that the ticket contains more than one. Do not pick the first one mentioned.

subject: Invitation never arrived for new hire
body: I invited a new colleague three days ago and she has not received the invitation email. I resent it twice. She checked spam.
rule: account_access: invitations that never arrived. Medium: one user affected with a workaround available.

subject: Every user charged twice in last night's billing run
body: Our finance team tells me every single one of our 340 seats was charged twice on last night's run. The total is roughly 18,000 EUR more than expected.
rule: Severity: money is moving incorrectly at scale. Escalation policy: money moved incorrectly, at any severity.

subject: Unsubscribe
body: unsubscribe
rule: close: automated and no-response-needed messages. other: not a support ticket.

subject: Filter returns results in wrong order
body: When I sort the contacts list by 'last activity' descending, the first three rows are always out of order. Everything below them is fine. Refreshing does not change it.
rule: technical: the product does not behave as documented. Medium: degraded with a reasonable workaround.

subject: Are you people even reading my emails
body: This is my fourth message. FOURTH. Our exports have been failing for a week for our largest account and every time I get told someone will look into it. Nobody has. We are moving 40,000 rows a day by hand at this point.
rule: Escalation policy: severity is high and sentiment is angry. A core workflow is broken for one customer and the workaround is manual and costly.

subject: How do I change my timezone?
body: Where in the settings do I change the timezone for my account? I looked under Profile and could not find it.
rule: auto_reply requires that search_kb actually returned a matching article. With no tools available in this request, never choose auto_reply; route to a human instead.

subject: Suspicious login attempts on our account
body: Our admin panel shows 60 failed login attempts overnight from IP addresses in a country we do not operate in. Nothing succeeded as far as I can tell. Should we be worried?
rule: Severity rules: unverified claims do not raise severity by themselves. Nothing succeeded, so no boundary has failed; this needs investigation, not a page.

subject: API docs say the field is optional but it is not
body: The API reference says 'external_id' is optional on POST /v1/contacts. Sending a request without it returns 400 with 'external_id is required'. One of the two is wrong.
rule: technical vs feature_request: if the documentation promises something the product does not do, it is technical — the documentation is part of the product.

subject: Downgrade did not refund the difference
body: I downgraded from Scale to Growth on the 3rd and expected a partial refund for the rest of the month. Nothing came through. Can you process it?
rule: billing: plan changes and refunds. Low: a question about policy rather than a defect, and no money moved incorrectly — the documented behaviour is that downgrades are not refunded.

subject: Delivery Status Notification (Failure)
body: This is an automatically generated Delivery Status Notification. Delivery to the following recipient failed permanently: noreply@example.invalid. Technical details of permanent failure: DNS Error.
rule: close: automated messages and bounces.

subject: Cannot reach the API at all this morning
body: Nothing works. Please advise urgently.
rule: request_more_info: unactionable as written — no error message, no endpoint, no indication of what 'nothing works' means. Do not infer a severity from how loudly it is described.

subject: Refund promised three weeks ago never arrived
body: You promised a refund three weeks ago for invoice INV-2231 and nothing has come through. This is the third time I am writing about it.
rule: Escalation policy does not fire: no money moved incorrectly — money that should have moved has not. High because it is overdue and repeatedly unaddressed.

subject: Payment page will not load in Firefox
body: The payment page is blank in Firefox 141. It works in Chrome. Console shows a CSP error blocking a script from your CDN.
rule: billing vs technical: the price is not wrong, the software is. A workaround exists (another browser), so medium.

subject: Sole admin locked out, no recovery codes
body: I am the only administrator on the account. I lost my phone and I never saved the recovery codes. Nobody else can promote a new admin and we cannot use the product at all.
rule: Severity: a customer is completely blocked with no workaround, and the only administrator is locked out. Escalation policy: severity is critical.

subject: Add a bulk edit button, this is ridiculous
body: I cannot believe a product at this price still has no way to edit more than one record at a time. I am clicking through 200 rows one by one. Sort it out.
rule: feature_request vs complaint: there is a concrete missing capability behind the frustration. Use complaint only when removing the emotion leaves nothing actionable.

subject: SSO returns 500 for all our users
body: Every SSO login attempt returns a 500 from your side. We have not changed anything in Okta — the certificate is valid until 2027 and the entity ID matches. Two other companies in our Slack group report the same thing this morning.
rule: account_access vs technical: an SSO login failing with a 500 on our side, for every customer, is technical. Critical: fully blocked with no workaround.

subject: Wrong customer's invoice attached to my email
body: The invoice PDF I received this morning is for a company called Halvorsen Logistics. Their address and bank details are on it. I assume they got mine.
rule: Severity: data exposed to the wrong party. Escalation policy: data exposed, at any severity. PII: bank details pasted into the ticket body.

subject: Tooltip overlaps the save button on mobile
body: On an iPhone in portrait the help tooltip on the billing form covers the save button. You can still save by rotating the phone.
rule: Severity: cosmetic with a workaround.

subject: Partnership opportunity
body: Hello, I represent a mid-sized consultancy and we would like to explore becoming a reseller of your platform in the Nordics. Who would be the right person to speak with?
rule: other: partnership requests. Not close — this is a genuine message that needs a human to route it, unlike spam.

subject: Same issue as ticket 8891
body: This is the same problem I reported in ticket 8891 yesterday. Opening a new one in case the first got lost. The webhook signature check fails on every delivery.
rule: close: duplicate submissions of a ticket already in flight.

subject: MFA reset for a departing employee
body: One of our team left and we need MFA reset on their account so we can recover the files they owned. Can support disable MFA for us?
rule: account_access: multi-factor authentication and permission changes. Medium: inconvenient with an admin-side path available.

subject: I think you have been hacked
body: A friend told me they saw something about a breach at your company on a forum. I have not seen anything myself but I wanted to check. Is our data safe?
rule: Severity rules: unverified claims do not raise severity by themselves. 'I think you have been hacked' with no evidence is medium and needs investigation.

subject: Seats billed for people who left
body: We removed four users in March and we are still being billed for nine seats instead of five. That is four months of overcharge at 39 EUR each.
rule: Escalation policy: money moved incorrectly, at any severity. billing: seat counts as they affect price.

subject: Slow
body: slow
rule: request_more_info: unactionable as written. Do not resolve an ambiguity by picking the more dramatic reading.

subject: Webhook fires twice for every event
body: Every event delivers two identical webhooks about 200ms apart, with the same event id. We have added deduplication on our side but it should not be necessary.
rule: technical: webhooks not behaving as documented. Medium: the customer has a working workaround in place.

subject: Contract says 99.9% uptime, we are seeing 97%
body: Our enterprise agreement guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime with service credits below that. Our own monitoring shows 97.2% for June. We will be claiming the credits and our legal team has been copied.
rule: Escalation policy: the customer states a contractual consequence. complaint: dissatisfaction with service against a policy rather than a specific defect.

subject: Update the contact on our account
body:
Please change the billing contact on our account to our new office manager:

Name: Priya Raghavan
Email: p.raghavan@vellmark.example
Mobile: +44 7700 900412
Address: 14 Wharfside Court, Leeds LS1 4AP

The old contact left the company.
rule: PII: email addresses, phone numbers and physical addresses in the body. This is a third party's data the customer pasted in, not the sender's own signature.

subject: Accessibility accommodation record upload failing
body: We upload employee accommodation records and one keeps failing validation. The row is: employee 4471, condition 'type 1 diabetes', reviewer Dr. Halloran, review date 2026-03-02. Every other row imports fine.
rule: PII: health information, or anything a data-protection regime would treat as a special category. Medium: one row fails and the rest import.

subject: Need SOC 2 evidence export before our audit
body: Our auditors need an export of all admin actions for the last 12 months in a machine-readable format. The UI only shows 90 days and only as HTML. Our SOC 2 Type II fieldwork starts on the 14th and we cannot pass this control without it.
rule: Severity: feature requests are almost never above low, except a request that is really a compliance or contractual blocker, which belongs to a human regardless of severity.

subject: Error when saving
body: I get an error when I try to save. It has happened a few times now. Can you look into it?
rule: request_more_info: no error message, no screen, no account identifier. 'It does not work' with no detail is not actionable.

subject: Your pricing change is unacceptable
body: We were told last week that the Growth tier is going up 22% at renewal with no new features. That is not a defect, it is a decision, and I want it on record that we think it is a poor one. We will be reviewing alternatives.
rule: complaint: dissatisfaction with the pricing model or a policy rather than a specific defect.
